title: [Decision] Readers can hide list columns but not add one: should a reader be able to add an object's field to their list?
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

The maintainer: 「等我决定的都要立卡，并且从业务的角度给我具体解释和我沟通」 (2026-11-04). Measured by the seat on `main` `63b86b385d`, on the example CRM unless noted. No `domain:*` label is set: triage routes this card.

## The question

显示 → 隐藏字段 lists only the columns the view already has. A rep who wants 负责人 or 距成交天数 on their list has to ask an administrator to change the view for everyone. #28971's first version excluded a field picker.

Governing text: #28971 「第一版不包含：…字段选择器」, #28912. A reader's list state lives in `sys_user_preference` (`perView.columnState`) and personal views in `sys_personal_view`.

## Measured

The opportunity list's 隐藏字段 lists 商机名称, 客户, 阶段, 金额, 赢单概率, 预期收入, 预计成交日期. The object also has 负责人, 距成交天数, 折扣 and others, offered in filter and sort but not here.

## Options

- **A. Add columns, personal only:** the panel lists every field the reader may read, and an added column is stored like a hidden one. Reset removes it.
- **B. Add columns only in My views,** not on a shared view's personalization.
- **C. Leave it.**

## Recommendation: A

## 四轴分析

**实际业务需求。** 不同角色看同一张表关心的列不一样：经理要负责人，财务要折扣。每周都可能遇到。今天的绕法是找管理员改全公司的视图，或者打开记录一条条看，代价很高。

**项目长远合理性。** 隐藏和添加是同一件事的两面，只能减不能加反而奇怪。字段权限已经有判断（`canReadField`），也不会越权。

**防 AI 写错。** 是用户偏好，不写元数据，AI 写应用时不受影响。

**创业阶段不扩散。** 改动在现有面板和偏好内。查询多一列可能影响性能，要按现有上限处理。

| 棱 | A | B | C |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 业务 | 强 | 中 | 弱 |
| 长远 | 强 | 中 | 弱 |
| 防错 | 强 | 强 | 强 |
| 不扩散 | 中 | 中 | 强 |

## Not measured

Lookup-field columns, which need extra expansion in the list read, and whether an added column survives the existing column-order and reset paths.

## Re-check

`git grep -n "hiddenFields" origin/main -- ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewListUrlState.ts`
